title: Council appoints Darshpreet Bhatti as Chief Administrative Officer
subtitle: Short special meeting also included a land acknowledgement, recognition of observances, and thanks to staff who covered added duties.
overview: Regional Council held a short special meeting on March 10, 2026, to consider one item: a by-law appointing the Region's Chief Administrative Officer. Council passed By-law 26-011, which appoints Darshpreet Bhatti to the role {{vote:m1}}. The by-law also repeals three earlier by-laws on the position: 20-027, 22-023 and 25-019.

The Chief Administrative Officer is the Region's top staff leader and leads the staff who carry out Council's decisions and deliver regional services. The appointment sets who holds that role going forward. The new CAO thanked Council for its trust and said they look forward to listening, learning and working on the community's priorities.

Before adjourning, the Regional Chair thanked the staff who took on extra tasks and portfolios in the lead-up to the appointment. The Chair said it was not a caretaker period and that important strategic work moved forward. Council adjourned at 9:07 a.m. {{vote:m2}}, and committee day followed after a short break.

decisions.item: Appointment of the Chief Administrative Officer (By-law 26-011)
decisions.detail: Council enacted By-law 26-011 appointing the Region's Chief Administrative Officer and repealing By-laws 20-027, 22-023 and 25-019 {{vote:m1}}.

debate: There was no debate on the by-law. It was moved, seconded and voted on after the new Chief Administrative Officer briefly introduced themself.
The new CAO said they recognize the responsibility that comes with the role and look forward to listening, learning and working on the priorities that matter most to the community.

The Regional Chair praised the depth of talent at the Region. The Chair thanked staff who took on added responsibilities and said the period was not a caretaker one, as strategic work continued for the community.
